name: Is mold always black after water damage?

mainEntity.name: Is mold always black after water damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, mold is not always black. While black mold is often talked about, mold can appear in a wide range of colors, including green, brown, white, gray, orange, and even purple or pink, depending on the species, moisture source, and food source. The color of mold is not a reliable indicator of its potential toxicity. All types of mold should be treated as potentially hazardous and professionally addressed, especially after water damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, mold comes in many colors, not just black. Its color doesn't indicate its danger level, and all mold should be addressed professionally.
